title: Answer with adj on and no decision key must proceed

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: In the daemon MethodRunAnswer case (internal/daemon/runs.go:750), refuse an empty p.By only when rec.Pending.Key is non-empty. With no key FileAnswer files nothing, so the answer proceeds as a plain answer. Change TestAnswerWithoutAdjDecidedByIsRefusedWithoutKey (internal/daemon/answer_adj_test.go:302) to expect success and no filing; keep the keyed test. Check internal/engine/answer_adj.go:20 for the same guard. Found in the S28 human check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/daemon ./internal/engine ./internal/tui; a keyed answer without ADJ_DECIDED_BY is still refused.
